class Solution:
    def minimumPushes(self, word: str) -> int:
        # Since all letters are distinct, the frequency of each letter is 1.
        # We want to minimize the sum of (position in key) for each letter.
        # There are 8 keys (2 to 9), each can have any number of letters.
        # The cost is sum of (index + 1) for each letter assigned to a key.
        # To minimize total cost, assign letters with highest frequency to positions with smallest index.
        # Here, all frequencies are 1, so just assign letters to positions in order.
        # The minimal cost is sum of positions 1..len(word), but letters are grouped in keys of max 26 letters.
        # The keys are 8, so max 8 keys, each can have multiple letters.
        # The cost is sum of (index_in_key + 1) for each letter.
        # So assign letters in order of frequency (all 1), so just assign letters to positions 1..len(word).
        # The cost is sum of positions in keys.
        # The first 8 letters cost 1 push each, next 8 cost 2 pushes each, etc.
        # So cost = sum over i of (i // 8 + 1), where i is index in sorted letters by frequency.

        n = len(word)
        # Sort letters by frequency descending, here all freq=1, so any order
        # Calculate cost by grouping letters in groups of 8
        cost = 0
        for i in range(n):
            cost += (i // 8) + 1
        return cost
